lessons.source_ref: Ministry Primary 1 T1 student book, Unit 6 Lesson 1, pdf p.104-107
lessons.goal_ar: النهارده هنتعرف على حيوانات الغابة ونعد رجليها ونقول مكانها.

steps.body_ar: Omar وLeila في الغابة. الجمل المهمة:
en: Leila: The monkey is in the tree!
Leila: There is a snake on the ground!
steps.body_en: Omar and Leila are in the jungle. Read the key sentences.

steps.body_ar: lion = أسد. tiger = نمر. monkey = قرد. elephant = فيل. giraffe = زرافة. snake = ثعبان. jungle = غابة.
steps.body_en: Learn these words: lion, tiger, monkey, elephant, giraffe, snake and jungle.

steps.body_ar: tiger يعني نمر. النمر عنده 4 legs.
steps.body_en: Learn the word tiger. A tiger has 4 legs.

steps.body_ar: elephant يعني فيل.
steps.body_en: Learn the word elephant.

steps.body_ar: monkey يعني قرد. القرد في الشجرة: in the tree.
en: The monkey is in the tree.
steps.body_en: Learn the word monkey. The monkey is in the tree.

steps.body_ar: lion يعني أسد. giraffe يعني زرافة. snake يعني ثعبان.
steps.body_en: Learn the words lion, giraffe and snake.

steps.body_ar: in يعني جوه: The monkey is in the tree. on يعني على: There is a snake on the ground.
en: The monkey is in the tree.
There is a snake on the ground.
steps.body_en: In means inside: The monkey is in the tree. On tells us something is on a surface: There is a snake on the ground.

steps.body_ar: How many lions can you see? ونرد: I can see 2 lions.
en: How many lions can you see?
steps.body_en: Ask How many lions can you see? Answer: I can see 2 lions.

steps.body_ar: رتّب الكلمات عشان تعمل جملة.
steps.body_en: Put the words in order to make a sentence.

steps.body_ar: كمّل المحادثة بنفسك.
steps.body_en: Complete the conversation yourself.

steps.body_ar: lion، tiger، monkey، elephant، giraffe، snake. A tiger has 4 legs. The monkey is in the tree.
steps.body_en: Lion, tiger, monkey, elephant, giraffe and snake. A tiger has 4 legs. The monkey is in the tree.

lessons.goal_en: Today we will learn about jungle animals, count their legs and say where they are.

lessons.source_ref: Ministry Primary 1 T1 student book, Unit 6 Lesson 2, pdf p.108-112
lessons.goal_ar: النهارده هنعرف حرفين: B وL، صوتهم وكلمات بتبدأ بيهم.

steps.body_ar: الحرف ليه اسم وصوت. اقرأ كلمات الدرس وشوف الحرف في أولها. الشرح هنا مكتوب، والنطق الصوتي هيتضاف بعد مراجعته.
steps.body_en: A letter has a name and a sound. Read the lesson words and find the letter at the beginning. This explanation is written; pronunciation audio will be added after review.

steps.body_ar: banana يعني موزة. بتبدأ بحرف b.
steps.body_en: Learn the word banana. It begins with b.

steps.body_ar: ball يعني كورة. بتبدأ بحرف b.
steps.body_en: Learn the word ball. It begins with b.

steps.body_ar: bird يعني عصفورة. boy يعني ولد. bike يعني عجلة. بيبدأوا بحرف b.
steps.body_en: Learn the words bird, boy and bike. They begin with b.

steps.body_ar: الحرف الكبير B والصغير b. اتتبّعهم واكتبهم واتبع الأسهم.
steps.body_en: The capital letter is B and the small letter is b. Trace and write them in your book. Follow the arrows.

steps.body_ar: رتّب الحروف وكوّن الكلمة.
steps.body_en: Put the letters in order to make the word.

steps.body_ar: الحرف ليه اسم وصوت. اقرأ كلمات الدرس وشوف الحرف في أولها. الشرح هنا مكتوب، والنطق الصوتي هيتضاف بعد مراجعته.
steps.body_en: A letter has a name and a sound. Read the lesson words and find the letter at the beginning. This explanation is written; pronunciation audio will be added after review.

steps.body_ar: lemon يعني ليمون. بتبدأ بحرف l.
steps.body_en: Learn the word lemon. It begins with l.

steps.body_ar: leaf يعني ورقة شجر. بتبدأ بحرف l.
steps.body_en: Learn the word leaf. It begins with l.

steps.body_ar: lamp يعني أباجورة. بتبدأ بحرف l.
steps.body_en: Learn the word lamp. It begins with l.

steps.body_ar: lion يعني أسد. lunch يعني غدا. بيبدأوا بحرف l.
steps.body_en: Learn the words lion and lunch. They begin with l.

steps.body_ar: الحرف الكبير L والصغير l. اتتبّعهم واكتبهم واتبع الأسهم.
steps.body_en: The capital letter is L and the small letter is l. Trace and write them in your book. Follow the arrows.

steps.body_ar: اختار الكلمة اللي بتبدأ بـ l مش b.
steps.body_en: Choose the word that begins with l, not b.

steps.body_ar: رتّب الحروف وكوّن الكلمة.
steps.body_en: Put the letters in order to make the word.

steps.body_ar: b: ball، bird، boy، banana، bike. l: lamp، lemon، lion، leaf، lunch.
steps.body_en: b: ball, bird, boy, banana, bike. l: lamp, lemon, lion, leaf, lunch.

lessons.goal_en: Today we will learn two letters, B and L, their sounds and words that begin with them.

lessons.source_ref: Ministry Primary 1 T1 student book, Unit 6 Lesson 3, pdf p.113-116
lessons.goal_ar: النهارده هنتعلم حيوانات أليفة وبنقول هي فين: in وon وunder.

steps.body_ar: Ali وHana بيتكلموا عن حيواناتهم الأليفة. الجمل المهمة:
en: Ali: The cat is on my leg!
Ali: The dog is on the couch.
Ali: The bird is in the cage.
Ali: The turtle is under the table!
steps.body_en: Ali and Hana are talking about their pets. Read the key sentences.

steps.body_ar: cat = قطة. dog = كلب. bird = عصفورة. turtle = سلحفاة. in = جوه. on = على. under = تحت. pet = حيوان أليف.
steps.body_en: Learn these pet words: cat, dog, bird and turtle. Learn the position words in, on and under. A pet is an animal you keep at home.

steps.body_ar: cat يعني قطة.
steps.body_en: Learn the word cat.

steps.body_ar: turtle يعني سلحفاة.
steps.body_en: Learn the word turtle.

steps.body_ar: cage يعني قفص. العصفورة بتعيش في قفص.
steps.body_en: Learn the word cage. The bird lives in a cage.

steps.body_ar: in يعني جوه. بص على الصورة: الكورة جوه الصندوق.
en: The ball is in the box.
steps.body_en: In means inside. Look at the picture: the ball is in the box.

steps.body_ar: on يعني على. بص على الصورة: الكورة على الترابيزة.
en: The ball is on the table.
steps.body_en: On tells us something is on a surface. Look at the picture: the ball is on the table.

steps.body_ar: under يعني تحت. بص على الصورة: الكورة تحت الترابيزة.
en: The ball is under the table.
steps.body_en: Under means below. Look at the picture: the ball is under the table.

steps.body_ar: Where is the dog? يعني الكلب فين؟ ونرد: The dog is on the couch.
en: The dog is on the couch.
steps.body_en: Ask Where is the dog? to find out its position. Answer: The dog is on the couch.

steps.body_ar: رتّب الكلمات عشان تعمل جملة.
steps.body_en: Put the words in order to make a sentence.

steps.body_ar: كمّل المحادثة بنفسك.
steps.body_en: Complete the conversation yourself.

steps.body_ar: cat، dog، bird، turtle. in جوه، on على، under تحت. Where is the dog?
steps.body_en: Cat, dog, bird and turtle. In means inside, on means on a surface, and under means below. Where is the dog?

lessons.goal_en: Today we will learn about pets and say where they are, using in, on and under.

lessons.source_ref: Ministry Primary 1 T1 student book, Unit 6 Lesson 4, pdf p.117-121

steps.body_ar: umbrella يعني شمسية. بتبدأ بحرف u.
steps.body_en: Learn the word umbrella. It begins with u.

steps.body_ar: up يعني لفوق. unlock يعني يفتح القفل.
steps.body_en: Up means towards a higher place. Unlock means to open a lock.

steps.body_ar: under يعني تحت. بص على الصورة: الكورة تحت الترابيزة.
steps.body_en: Under means below. Look at the picture: the ball is under the table.

steps.body_ar: الحرف الكبير U والصغير u. اتتبّعهم واكتبهم واتبع الأسهم.
steps.body_en: The capital letter is U and the small letter is u. Trace and write them in your book. Follow the arrows.

steps.body_ar: الحرف ليه اسم وصوت. اقرأ كلمات الدرس وشوف الحرف في أولها. الشرح هنا مكتوب، والنطق الصوتي هيتضاف بعد مراجعته.
steps.body_en: A letter has a name and a sound. Read the lesson words and find the letter at the beginning. This explanation is written; pronunciation audio will be added after review.

steps.body_ar: jam يعني مربى. بتبدأ بحرف j.
steps.body_en: Learn the word jam. It begins with j.

steps.body_ar: jar يعني برطمان. بتبدأ بحرف j.
steps.body_en: Learn the word jar. It begins with j.

steps.body_ar: jacket يعني جاكت. بتبدأ بحرف j.
steps.body_en: Learn the word jacket. It begins with j.

steps.body_ar: jellyfish يعني قنديل البحر. jeans يعني بنطلون جينز. بيبدأوا بحرف j.
steps.body_en: Learn the words jellyfish and jeans. They begin with j.

steps.body_ar: الحرف الكبير J والصغير j. اتتبّعهم واكتبهم واتبع الأسهم.
steps.body_en: The capital letter is J and the small letter is j. Trace and write them in your book. Follow the arrows.

steps.body_ar: اختار الكلمة اللي بتبدأ بـ j مش u.
steps.body_en: Choose the word that begins with j, not u.

steps.body_ar: رتّب الحروف وكوّن الكلمة.
steps.body_en: Put the letters in order to make the word.

steps.body_ar: u: up، unlock، umbrella، under. j: jam، jacket، jar، jellyfish، jeans.
steps.body_en: u: up, unlock, umbrella, under. j: jam, jacket, jar, jellyfish, jeans.
